description.subtitle: Puma Football Shin Guards with Support Tights - Blue
description.intro: The Puma Ultra Flex Sleeve are designed to offer comfort and freedom of movement with a structure that adapts to the contour of the leg.
key_benefits: Total flexibility: Ergonomic design that adapts to the movement of the game.
Controlled compression: Stockings that stabilize and secure without excessive tightening.
Sports style: Modern image with visual impact graphics.
Functional protection: Resistant panels where more security is needed.
Natural feel: Play freely without feeling stiff.
